The amphibian displays a robust body with vivid yellow and black mottling. Its skin appears glossy and moist. The head is visible on the left, showing small dark eyes and parotoid glands. Forelimbs and hindlimbs are splayed, revealing distinct digits with light-colored tips. The tail extends towards the upper right, showing a striped pattern.
